provenance.note: Metallic-cartridge black-powder revolvers of a regular army. A.3.21.4.1 excludes this discipline from the hole-centre rule of the black-powder disciplines, so rings are scored by touch. The three series have different times (50, 25 and 15 s), so no time is set; sighting time is 5 min.
